title: Launch Funnel System
description: A reference-led app launch series: one hero identity board followed by feature, store, and social adaptations that preserve the same product UI language.
creative_direction: Use one premium productivity-app identity as the anchor, then fan out into landing-page storytelling, app-store promotion, and social launch crops without losing device realism or UI hierarchy.
